def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="textlab demo workload")
    ap.add_argument("--small", action="store_true", help="quick run (about a quarter of the work)")
    scale = 1 if ap.parse_args().small else 4
    stage_text(scale)
    stage_sim(scale)
    stage_ml(scale)
    stage_features(scale)
    print("done")
